title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Reinstatement and Redemption Terms
content:
Terms on which a borrower may get a repossessed vehicle back under Repossession and Collateral Recovery. The terms are the same in each collateral class (Recovery Class 1 Passenger Car through Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van).

| Term | All classes |
|---|---|
| The company offers reinstatement after repossession in every state | yes |
| Maximum reinstatements after repossession over the life of one contract, count | 1 |
| Calendar days a reinstatement quote is good through, never past the earliest sale date | 5 |
| Accepted proof of the borrower's physical-damage insurance must be on file before a reinstated vehicle is released | yes |
| Payment channels accepted for reinstatement, redemption and recovery expenses | debit card taken by an agent, MoneyGram, wire transfer, certified funds |
| Business days after good funds within which a reinstated or redeemed vehicle is released | 2 |
| Until when the borrower may redeem | any time before the vehicle is sold (UCC 9-623) |

## Points of judgement

- The accepted channels form one list of four: a debit card taken by an agent, MoneyGram, a wire transfer and certified funds.
- One reinstatement after repossession is the life-of-contract maximum in all classes.
- A quote is good for 5 calendar days at most, and never past the earliest sale date.
- The redemption deadline is stated by an event, the sale of the vehicle, rather than by a count of days.
